issue.title: Plugin updates through httpie interface
issue.body:
Context: https://github.com/httpie/httpie/pull/1228#discussion_r764267920

The UI can be one of these:
- `httpie plugins install --upgrade <bla bla>` (I think less intuitive)
- `httpie plugins update <bla bla>`
- `httpie plugins upgrade <bla bla>` (same with apt)
